Title: ViewStartProvider - Default Starting View Provider
Summary: IViewStartProvider implementation that provides the default starting view entry for Cyréna. Returns a single ViewStart pointing to the root path with a default description.

## ViewStartProvider

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Services`  
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Components.Runtime`  
**Implements**: `IViewStartProvider`

### Purpose
Provides the default starting view for the Cyréna application. Returns a single `ViewStart` entry pointing to the root path (`/`).

### Implementation

```csharp
internal class ViewStartProvider : IViewStartProvider
{
    public IEnumerable<ViewStart> Provide()
    {
        var index = new ViewStart()
        {
            Href = "/",
            Title = "Default",
            Description = "Start a conversation with any of your assistants."
        };
        return [index];
    }
}
```

### Provided ViewStart

| Property | Value | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| `Href` | `"/"` | Navigation URL (root path) |
| `Title` | `"Default"` | Display title |
| `Description` | `"Start a conversation with any of your assistants."` | Description shown in UI |

### Registration

Registered at the application level (not per-kernel) by `CyrenaBuilderExtensions.AddComponents()`:

```csharp
builder.Services.AddScoped<IViewStartProvider, ViewStartProvider>();
```

### Usage

The application queries all registered `IViewStartProvider` services to build the list of available starting views. Users can select a starting view in their settings, which determines the page shown when the application loads.
